# Account Hub helper suppression preserves space and follows the error-state selector

The landing hides the helper immediately after input-control with visibility:hidden when an invalid or warning input precedes an error message inside the control. This keeps the helper's space while avoiding visual overlap. Its new fixture and three registered browser tasks directly assert helper/error visibility for user-invalid, manual-invalid and warning states. At the fixed accepted revision, manual error selection uses aria-invalid instead of .manual-input:invalid. These tests do not directly assert layout geometry or accessible descriptions.

Scope: Account Hub form styling and browser visibility tests.
